about.label: Manifesto
about.title: About Pinta-me
about.body: Pinta-me is a subscription club bringing Brazilian art to mailboxes in Brazil and around the world. Each month a different artist creates an exclusive piece turned into an envelope full of color and care.
about.body2: No screens: paper, color and care. A real letter crossing the city or the ocean.
